'''Blaide''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Kabaira]]. He infiltrated the local Rebel cell and [[Skirmish on Kabaira|betrayed]] it in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. He was killed by [[Tere Metallo]].<ref name="Passages" />
